{"id":1846163043,"question_id":44,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1764785203,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1846163043/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Wildcard Matching","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool byrec(string s , string p , int  i , int  j)\n    {\n        //base cases\n        if(i == s.size() and j == p.size()) return true;\n        if(j == p.size()) return false;\n        if(i == s.size())\n        {\n            while(j < p.size())\n            {\n                if(p[j] != '*') return false;\n                j++;\n            }\n        return true;\n        }\n\n        //ek case hum solve karenge \n        //matching case \n        bool ans = false;\n        if(p[j] == '?' or s[i] == p[j])\n        {\n            return byrec(s , p , i+1 , j+1);\n        }\n        else \n        {\n            //non matching case\n            bool op1 = byrec(s , p , i+1 , j);\n            bool op2 = byrec(s , p , i , j+1);\n            ans = op1 or op2;\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n\n    bool isMatch(string s, string p) {\n        return byrec(s , p , 0 , 0);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"wildcard-matching","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1224}
